definitions.explanation: A violent weather disturbance with strong winds and often rain or snow.
A period of intense trouble or activity (figurative).

examples.japanese: {嵐|あらし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: A storm seems to be coming.

examples.japanese: {嵐|あらし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{静|しず}けさ→静けさ：14614_shizukesa⟧。
{嵐|あらし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何本|なんぼん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: Several trees fell over in the storm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嵐|あらし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A storm of applause broke out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嵐|あらし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦さらされた→晒す：04609_sarasu⟧。
examples.english: They were exposed to a storm of criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嵐|あらし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えてきた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I have weathered the storms of life.

notes:
{嵐|あらし} means storm, both literally and figuratively.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嵐|あらし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (a storm is coming)
- {嵐|あらし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (the storm passes)
- {嵐|あらし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{静|しず}けさ→静けさ：14614_shizukesa⟧ (calm before the storm)
- ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嵐|あらし} (storm of applause)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧: typhoon (specific type)
- {嵐|あらし}: storm (general)
- ⟦{暴風雨|ぼうふうう}→暴風雨：07670_boufuuu⟧: windstorm with rain (technical)
